title: Luc Montagnier on electromagnetic information transfer in DNA

tellings.quote: and you had this guy Luke Monier who's this French Nobel Prize winner at the end of his life if he was saying you know electromagnetism is really important for communication information transfer within DNA

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Luc Montagnier, a French scientist who won the Nobel Prize. Michels says that at the end of his life Montagnier argued that electromagnetism, the force behind light and radio, is important for passing information within DNA, the molecule that carries our genes. Michels uses this to suggest that life may communicate in ways science does not yet accept.
